description: What the main window's webview may ask of the app: its own nine commands (listed in build.rs) and nothing else: `boot`, `storage_set`, `dialog_confirm`, `dialog_alert`, `open_external`, `save_begin`, `save_write`, `save_finish` and `save_discard`. No core or plug-in permission is granted: the page does not listen for events or call a window API, and dialogs, file dialogs and links are opened from Rust.
